messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Malayalam, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Malayalam line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table (Source → Malayalam)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase (Step 2) | Back‑Translation (Malayalam → English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------|------------------------------------------|--------| | **mosse** | “first moment / hour” | **ആദ്യമണിയും** | “first moment” | OK | | **di** (prep. “of”) | genitive linking “prima” to “mosse” | **കാലത്തിന്റെ** | “of time” (genitive) | OK | | **prima** | “first” (temporal) | **ആദ്യ** (part of ആദ്യമണിയും) | “first” | OK | | **quelle** | demonstrative “those” | **അവയൊക്കെ** | “those” | OK | | **cose** | “things” (beautiful) | **മധുരകാലവും** | “sweet season” (interpreted as “beautiful things”) | OK | | **belle** | “beautiful / sweet” | **മധുര** (part of മധുരകാലവും) | “sweet” | OK | | **sì** | resultative “so … that” | — (not rendered) | — | **MISSING** | | **ch'a** | causal “that …” | **എനിക്ക്** | “to me” (used as indirect object) | **WRONG** | | **bene** | “good” (quality of hope) | **നല്ല** | “good” | OK | | **sperar** | infinitive “to hope” | **പ്രതീക്ഷ** | “hope” | OK | | **m'era** | “to me was” (experiencer) | **കാരണമായി** | “as a cause” (used as predicate) | **WRONG** | | **cagione** | “cause / occasion” | **കാരണമായി** | “as a cause” | OK | | **di** (line 42) | preposition “of / concerning” | — (not rendered) | — | **MISSING** | | **quella** | demonstrative “that” (referring to beast) | **അവിടെ** | “there” (locative, not demonstrative) | **WRONG** | | **fiera** | “wild beast” | **കാട്ടുമൃഗം** (stem in കാട്ടുമൃഗത്തെക്കുറിച്ച്) | “wild animal” | OK | | **a** | preposition “with” | **ഉള്ള** | “with / having” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” (feminine) | — (article omitted) | — | **UNNECESSARY** | | **gaetta** | “dappled / speckled” | **ചിതറിച്ചർമ്മമുള്ള** | “spotted / dappled” | OK | | **pelle** | “skin” (attribute of beast) | — (not rendered) | — | **MISSING** |
---
### Summary of Issues
- **MISSING**: - *sì* (resultative “so”) – omitted, breaking the “so … that” construction. - *di* (line 42) – the preposition “of / concerning” is absent. - *pelle* – the attribute “skin” is not expressed.
- **WRONG**: - *ch'a* rendered as **എനിക്ക്** (“to me”) instead of a causal/conjunctive marker. - *m'era* rendered as **കാരണമായി** (“as a cause”) rather than the copular “to me was”. - *quella* rendered as **അവിടെ** (“there”) instead of the demonstrative “that”.
- **UNNECESSARY**: - *la* – the definite article is naturally omitted in Malayalam; its inclusion would be redundant.
- **GRAMMAR**: None of the rendered Malayalam words show overt agreement errors, but the omission of the resultative particle (*sì*) and the mis‑rendering of *ch'a* and *m'era* affect the clause‑linking grammar.
These points indicate that the Step 2 translation needs revision to faithfully preserve the logical structure and all lexical items of the source.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Malayalam script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Malayalam text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 40** - Original: കാലത്തിന്റെ ആദ്യമണിയും മധുരകാലവും; - Issue: none - Corrected: കാലത്തിന്റെ ആദ്യമണിയും മധുരകാലവും;
- **Line 41** - Original: അവയൊക്കെ എനിക്ക് നല്ല പ്രതീക്ഷയുടെ കാരണമായി - Issue: missing resultative “so” (sì), wrong rendering of “ch’a”, missing proper “to me was” structure. - Corrected: അങ്ങനെ, നല്ല പ്രതീക്ഷ എനിക്ക് കാരണമായി
- **Line 42** - Original: അവിടെ ഉള്ള ചിതറിച്ചർമ്മമുള്ള കാട്ടുമൃഗത്തെക്കുറിച്ച്. - Issue: wrong demonstrative, missing “that”, missing explicit “skin” (pelle). - Corrected: അത് കാട്ടുമൃഗം ചിതറിച്ചർമ്മമുള്ള തൊലിയുള്ളതിനെക്കുറിച്ച്.
```malayalam കാലത്തിന്റെ ആദ്യമണിയും മധുരകാലവും; അങ്ങനെ, നല്ല പ്രതീക്ഷ എനിക്ക് കാരണമായി അത് കാട്ടുമൃഗം ചിതറിച്ചർമ്മമുള്ള തൊലിയുള്ളതിനെക്കുറിച്ച്. ```
